# NeuralNg launch copy

## Short announcement

NeuralNg is now open source: an Angular 22+ UI library designed first for coding agents and fully usable by human developers. It includes 51 documented components, 6,184 icons, Signal-native APIs, accessibility contracts, SSR-safe behavior, `llms.txt` context and a read-only MCP server.

https://neuralng.dev
https://github.com/hasanaydin7/NeuralTech

## Community post

I have released the first public beta of NeuralNg, an Angular 22+ component system designed first for coding agents and fully usable by human developers.

The focus is making UI generation deterministic for agents. Every public component has an exact secondary entry point and machine-readable contract; the project also ships component-level `llms.txt` files, a read-only MCP server and a portable Agent Skill.

The beta currently includes 51 documented components, 6,184 icons, Signal-native APIs, Angular Forms integration, SSR-safe behavior, native accessibility contracts, theming and an unstyled mode.

I would especially value feedback on:

- whether the component APIs feel natural in real Angular applications;
- whether MCP and `llms.txt` reduce incorrect generated imports and selectors;
- which missing component would block adoption.

Docs: https://neuralng.dev
GitHub: https://github.com/hasanaydin7/NeuralTech
